description: Synthetic seed corpus shipped with the repo so the live-corpus gate has something deterministic to chew on. Emulates a small mixed-tool-output session - not real-session data. Real captures land under sibling directories per docs/live-corpus-policy.md once the maintainer captures them.
notes: Numbers chosen to keep this fixture stable across compression-tuning changes. If a future tuning legitimately moves the ratio outside [min, max] the maintainer adjusts these bounds explicitly rather than silently.
